"""Dispatch the frozen server rebuild only after the same-source whole build."""
from pathlib import Path
import base64
import hashlib
import json
import socket
import subprocess
import time

from cold_prefill_tail_build_evidence_r1 import validate_build as validate_whole

B = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
read = lambda p: json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
sha = lambda p: hashlib.file_digest(p.open('rb'), 'sha256').hexdigest()
assert socket.gethostname().split('.')[0].lower() != 'baiying'
manifest = B / 'cold-prefill-tail-server-source-r2.json'
m = read(manifest)
# No network or persistent dispatch output precedes this prerequisite.
assert sha(B / m['whole_build_validator']) == m['whole_build_validator_sha256']
whole = validate_whole()
assert whole['source_manifest_sha256'] == m['whole_source_manifest_sha256']
assert whole['source_commit'] == m['source_commit'] and whole['repo'] == m['repo']
for key in ('script', 'dispatcher', 'verifier'):
    assert sha(B / m[key]) == m[key + '_sha256']
binding = B / 'cold-prefill-tail-server-build-binding-r2.json'
with binding.open('x') as f:
    json.dump(dict(source_manifest_sha256=sha(manifest), whole_build_run_sha256=whole['run_sha256'],
                   whole_build_evidence=whole), f, indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
d = B / m['run_directory']
d.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
opts = ['-o', 'BatchMode=yes', '-o', 'ConnectTimeout=10']
subprocess.run(['scp', *opts, str(manifest), str(binding), str(B / m['script']),
                'baiying:D:/projects/'], check=True, timeout=45)
ps = ("$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$t=$null;$e=$null;"
      "$null=[Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile('D:/projects/" + m['script'] +
      "',[ref]$t,[ref]$e);if($e.Count){throw ($e|Out-String)}")
parsed = subprocess.run(['ssh', *opts, 'baiying', 'powershell.exe -NoProfile -EncodedCommand ' +
                         base64.b64encode(ps.encode('utf-16le')).decode()],
                        capture_output=True, text=True, errors='replace', timeout=30)
with (d / 'script-parse.json').open('x') as f:
    json.dump(dict(returncode=parsed.returncode, stdout=parsed.stdout, stderr=parsed.stderr), f, indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
parsed.check_returncode()
command = ['ssh', *opts, 'baiying', 'powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File D:/projects/' + m['script']]
start = time.monotonic()
try:
    result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, errors='replace', timeout=m['transport_timeout_seconds'])
    record = dict(command=command, returncode=result.returncode, stdout=result.stdout, stderr=result.stderr,
                  wall_seconds=time.monotonic() - start)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
    record = dict(command=command, returncode=None, timeout=True, wall_seconds=time.monotonic() - start,
                  stdout=str(exc.stdout), stderr=str(exc.stderr))
    with (d / 'dispatch.json').open('x') as f:
        json.dump(record, f, indent=2)
        f.write('\n')
    raise
with (d / 'dispatch.json').open('x') as f:
    json.dump(record, f, indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
transfers = []
for directory, prefix, files in [
    (m['run_directory'], '', ['run-record.json', 'product.stdout.jsonl', 'product.stderr.log',
                              'preflight.json', 'launch.json', 'telemetry.jsonl']),
    (m['build_directory'], 'server-', ['build-provenance.json', 'build.stdout.txt', 'build.stderr.txt',
                                     'build-qrt-server.bat', 'qrt.exe']),
]:
    for file in files:
        transfer = subprocess.run(['scp', *opts, 'baiying:' + m['repo'] + '/build/' + directory + '/' + file,
                                   str(d / (prefix + file))], capture_output=True, text=True, errors='replace', timeout=45)
        transfers.append(dict(file=prefix + file, returncode=transfer.returncode, stderr=transfer.stderr))
with (d / 'transfers.json').open('x') as f:
    json.dump(transfers, f, indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
if (d / 'run-record.json').is_file():
    run = read(d / 'run-record.json')
    print(json.dumps({k: run[k] for k in ('reason', 'exit_code', 'wall_ms', 'host_checks_pass')}), flush=True)
if result.returncode:
    print(result.stderr[-2500:], flush=True)
result.check_returncode()
assert all(t['returncode'] == 0 for t in transfers)
from cold_prefill_tail_server_evidence_r2 import validate_build
print(json.dumps(validate_build(), indent=2), flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import re
import struct
import subprocess

from cold_prefill_tail_build_evidence_r1 import validate_build as validate_whole

B = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
P = Path('<evidence-home-1>/projects/AIMA-public-r1191-candidate')
read = lambda p: json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
sha = lambda p: hashlib.file_digest(p.open('rb'), 'sha256').hexdigest()

def validate_build():
    mp = B / 'cold-prefill-tail-server-source-r2.json'
    m = read(mp)
    d = B / m['run_directory']
    run = read(d / 'run-record.json')
    whole = validate_whole()
    assert whole['source_manifest_sha256'] == m['whole_source_manifest_sha256']
    assert whole['source_commit'] == m['source_commit'] == 'a7e2092d4cbe68f5f8ce4b61c8dd708453ac25b3'
    assert whole['repo'] == m['repo']
    assert run['host'].lower() == 'baiying' and run['reason'] == 'completed' and run['exit_code'] == 0
    assert run['host_checks_pass'] and all(run['host_checks'].values()) and not run['after_processes']
    assert read(d / 'preflight.json')['pass'] and read(d / 'dispatch.json')['returncode'] == 0
    assert read(d / 'script-parse.json')['returncode'] == 0
    assert all(t['returncode'] == 0 for t in read(d / 'transfers.json'))
    spec = run['spec']
    assert spec['repo_commit'] == m['source_commit'] and spec['whole_build_run_sha256'] == whole['run_sha256']
    assert spec['source_manifest_sha256'] == sha(mp) and spec['command_file_sha256'] == m['script_sha256']
    assert {x['file']: x['sha256'] for x in spec['source_inputs']} == m['source_sha256']
    for key in ('script', 'dispatcher', 'verifier'):
        assert sha(B / m[key]) == m[key + '_sha256']
    assert sha(B / m['whole_build_validator']) == m['whole_build_validator_sha256']
    for name, digest in m['source_sha256'].items():
        assert hashlib.sha256(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', m['source_commit'] + ':' + name],
                                                     cwd=P, timeout=15)).hexdigest() == digest
    meta = read(d / 'server-build-provenance.json')
    assert meta['host'].lower() == 'baiying' and meta['repo_commit'] == m['source_commit']
    assert not meta['dirty_tree'] and meta['tests_run'] and not meta['validate_only']
    assert meta['timeout_seconds'] == m['compile_and_test_timeout_seconds'] == 900
    assert meta['context_limits_header_sha256'] == m['source_sha256']['native/src/qrt_context_limits.h']
    exe = d / 'server-qrt.exe'
    assert sha(exe) == meta['executable_sha256']
    pe = exe.read_bytes()
    assert pe[:2] == b'MZ'
    pe_offset = struct.unpack_from('<I', pe, 0x3c)[0]
    assert pe[pe_offset:pe_offset + 4] == b'PE\0\0'
    optional = pe_offset + 24
    assert struct.unpack_from('<H', pe, optional)[0] == 0x20b
    stack_reserve = struct.unpack_from('<Q', pe, optional + 72)[0]
    assert stack_reserve == 268435456
    stdout = (d / 'server-build.stdout.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    assert 'test result: ok. 54 passed; 0 failed;' in stdout
    tests = re.findall(r'test result: (\w+)\. (\d+) passed; (\d+) failed;', stdout)
    assert tests and all(kind == 'ok' and int(failed) == 0 for kind, _, failed in tests)
    command_file = (d / 'server-build-qrt-server.bat').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    assert 'fmt --package qrt-server -- --check' in command_file
    assert 'test -p qrt-server --no-fail-fast' in command_file
    assert 'build -p qrt-server --release' in command_file
    return dict(source_commit=m['source_commit'], repo=m['repo'], source_manifest=mp.name,
        source_manifest_sha256=sha(mp), source_inputs=len(m['source_sha256']),
        run_directory=d.name, run_sha256=sha(d / 'run-record.json'),
        build_metadata_sha256=sha(d / 'server-build-provenance.json'),
        artifact=dict(path=meta['executable'], sha256=sha(exe), bytes=exe.stat().st_size),
        command_file_sha256=sha(d / 'server-build-qrt-server.bat'),
        stdout_sha256=sha(d / 'server-build.stdout.txt'), stderr_sha256=sha(d / 'server-build.stderr.txt'),
        stack_reserve_bytes=stack_reserve, library_tests_passed=54, whole_build=whole,
        model_loaded=False, inference_acceptance=False, performance_acceptance=False, release_qualified=False)

"""Freeze a server rebuild containing the same C core as the cold-tail CLI."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess

B = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
P = Path('<evidence-home-1>/projects/AIMA-public-r1191-candidate')
read = lambda p: json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
sha = lambda p: hashlib.file_digest(p.open('rb'), 'sha256').hexdigest()
whole_path = B / 'cold-prefill-tail-whole-source-r1.json'
whole = read(whole_path)
commit = whole['source_commit']
assert commit == 'a7e2092d4cbe68f5f8ce4b61c8dd708453ac25b3'

def git_bytes(name):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', commit + ':' + name], cwd=P, timeout=15)

def closure(names):
    seen = set()
    todo = [P / n for n in names]
    while todo:
        path = todo.pop().resolve()
        if path in seen:
            continue
        assert path.is_relative_to(P)
        seen.add(path)
        for inc in re.findall(r'^\s*#include "([^"\n]+)"', path.read_text(), re.M):
            target = next((q for q in [(path.parent / inc).resolve(), (P / inc).resolve(),
                                       (P / 'native/src' / inc).resolve()] if q.is_file()), None)
            assert target, (path, inc)
            todo.append(target)
    return {str(p.relative_to(P)) for p in seen}

c_inputs = closure(['native/src/qrt.c', 'native/src/qwen36_baseline.c', 'native/src/qrt_server_bridge.c'])
rust_inputs = set(subprocess.check_output(
    ['git', 'ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', commit, '--', 'engine/qrt-server'],
    cwd=P, text=True, timeout=15).splitlines())
assert len(rust_inputs) == 10
assert not any('include_str!' in (P / n).read_text() or 'include_bytes!' in (P / n).read_text()
               for n in rust_inputs)
names = c_inputs | rust_inputs | {
    'Cargo.toml', 'Cargo.lock', 'engine/qrt-cli/Cargo.toml',
    'scripts/baiying_build_qrt_server.ps1', 'scripts/baiying_guarded_inference.ps1',
    'scripts/baiying_boot_identity.ps1',
}
sources = {}
for name in sorted(names):
    digest = hashlib.sha256(git_bytes(name)).hexdigest()
    assert sha(P / name) == digest
    sources[name] = digest
for name in c_inputs & set(whole['source_sha256']):
    assert sources[name] == whole['source_sha256'][name]
prior_path = B / 'tool-text-parts-native-source-r2.json'
prior = read(prior_path)
changed = [n for n in sorted(c_inputs | rust_inputs) if prior['source_sha256'].get(n) != sources[n]]
assert changed == ['native/src/qrt.c', 'native/src/qrt.h'], changed

for file in ('run-native-cold-prefill-tail-server-r2.ps1', 'dispatch_cold_prefill_tail_server_r2.py',
             'cold_prefill_tail_server_evidence_r2.py'):
    path = B / file
    assert path.is_file()
